q: What protects against bland, repetitive synthetic eval data?
options: Seeding generation with explicit dimensions such as persona, task and difficulty, then filtering
explain: Structured variety plus filtering beats free-form generation.

q: What keeps synthetic data from teaching errors?
options: Verification, deduplication and filtering, plus mixing with real data
Degradation from training repeatedly on model-generated data, narrowing the distribution

q: Where must synthetic-data models always be evaluated?
options: On real held-out data the generator never saw
explain: Otherwise the score flatters the generator’s style.
